title: Boolean-network learning prioritizes an IBD organoid barrier target
summary: Learning from transcriptomic networks helped prioritize PRKAB1 for experimental follow-up. An agonist improved a barrier-resistance endpoint in about 80% of diseased patient-derived organoids in the tested sample. This is preclinical target-response evidence, not treatment of patients or clinical efficacy. The network direction incorporates sample labels and does not independently establish causal disease progression.
ai_technology: Boolean Network Explorer learned implication networks
organization: University of California San Diego; Assiut University

evidence.tested: Patient-derived organoid barriers and preclinical models were tested.
evidence.unknown: Clinical safety and benefit, independent replication and causal network direction remain unestablished.
evidence.ai_role: Boolean Network Explorer learned implication networks supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Primary article metadata, affiliations, selected network Methods and organoid Results; supplements not reviewed.
